items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998

ctx.x: Ed Thigpen. And Roy Haynes even liked him.

Roy Haynes loved him, you know, because both of them came up to the Vine Street Grill when we were playing, and they were just sitting there checking out John. He said be sure, I want to meet him, have him come to my table. Because he says I don’t believe what I’m seeing and hearing simultaneously. He said I haven’t seen this in years. A drummer, the way he is comping and playing and expressing.
